tasks.title: E24 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E24 (Warnings engine). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E24.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E24/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E24/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Warnings safety core and real HTTP acceptance
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. Read every current docs/build/*/tasks.json before touching owned paths. E24's design is frozen. Implement SYSTEM and Part A first, then unresolved review requirements, then the design. Do not edit the design, contracts, another task, another epic or shared tooling. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, contracts/api/ and deployment config were absent; recheck existence before creating the listed files. Read docs/requests/E24.md if the coordinator has since filed it; it was absent and its missing proposals are not approvals. PLAN Requests are a handoff, not a replacement decision record. Return any further missing declaration to the coordinator for that request file before dependent code. Do not invent types, fields, ports, handler identities, tables, settings, CLI registration or a permissive substitute.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 identifiers; 5.2 captured TimeInput segments, ClockCorrections/NormalizedTime and HLC; 5.3 MissionClock opaque versions; 5.4 Quantity(Decimal, Unit), WireQuantity/WireUnitConverter and sourced PressureContext; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle/ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard/TemplateRenderer; 5.7 UnitOfWork/StorageSession/ReadSnapshot, bus, audiences and transactional outbox; 5.7.1 Delivery/Recipient/projections and revocation; 5.8 command_identity/CommandIdentity/CommandPolicy/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/AcceptedReceipt; 5.9 complete reference-only AuditEntry/hash chain; 5.10 ScheduledJob/AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline with generations and HealthState; 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation/EvaluationInput/EvaluatorRegistration; 5.11 typed HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry and create_app(settings). Never implement replacements. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv --project hub, pnpm, generated Python and @crew-health/contracts, static discovery and generated import rules; 8.1 supplies canonical seams/Q9; 8.2 guidance; 8.3/8.4 object/field grants versus action authority; 8.6 durability; 9/10 dependency order and kernel.testing. Missing provider code means unit work against its published protocol and E01 kernel fakes, never a production fake or new copy of its module. Missing kernel fakes themselves are a prerequisite.

Apply these binding deviations in this task. D1 keeps active definition/content/limit/clear pins through edits/removal; new inputs use the new release for new raises, never silently change an old warning's clear rule. Do not clear from activation/environment switching or impose a blanket active-definition removal veto; retain pins and show withdrawn state once its agreed projection exists. R-E23-19 is needed for separate pinned sensor results. D3 requires corrected observation time with the whole uncertainty interval inside freshness and strictly later evidence than the warning raise; unknown/future/regressed time never clears. D14 gives REPLAY freshness only to advancing E's durable receive reference; its windows/dwell stay on original data time and cannot clear LIVE/SIM. D2 makes shelter Emergency now. Q9 routes sleep Act to an awake officer/on-duty crew member, waits the sourced interval, then wakes the sleeper only if no awake acknowledgement; Emergency wakes everyone, lower items defer, EVA suppression stays. No guessed interval, recipient, consent or routing state. Q1/Q7/Q18 permit sourced, hash/purpose/pin/applicability-eligible unreviewed guidance with the visible review label; clinical sign-off is not a runtime gate. The missing warning_steps ContentRef kind must be agreed before use. SIM/REPLAY do not waive missing source/purpose.

Only E01 EvaluationIsolation may catch EvaluatorComputationFailure and persist/retry pending work. No rules_pending table, local recovery queue, coalescing/overflow replay, catch-all isolation or operator quarantine that resumes clears. Forbidden storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config/input errors abort the whole producer. Original input time/release/version/revision and completion identity survive recovery; older success never clears/replaces newer state. Shared pending state must freeze automatic clears, including E23 failures before constructing SensorEvaluated. R-E23-18 lacks the UOW read signature: until resolved automatic sensor clearing remains unavailable/degraded and V56 remains incomplete. Health only exposes contracted overall degraded status; do not fabricate evaluator/since JSON. Elapsed timers use shared anchors/generations, absolute contact deadlines stay fixed. Do not hand-shift scheduler timestamps.

Privacy is current object, field, purpose and action access on every read/event/replay/export. HelpSessionReader.readable_by and ClinicalAuthorityQuery alone grant no chart. A helper has only the existing limited authorized help summary; an officer/acting assignment is not a warning read grant. Manual rule/sensor resolution requires medical-officer authorization, explicit object/action access and nonempty reason under D1; never merely self plus person_may_resolve, and no unapproved general acting-officer resolution. R-E24-21 needs those bindings. No person warning export under rules/operational/1. Client private projections are memory-only and purge before session transition or lock; logs/errors/caches contain no private text. Every mutable operation uses full target/semantic-header/body identity, no durable=True. Reauthorize saved results before replay, mismatch returns DUPLICATE_COMMAND with null current_state, authorized late match returns the closed accepted_command receipt, never a current Warning as the receipt. HMAC protects sensitive bodies; P2 responses are not cached as plaintext.

All operational limits come from approved bounded settings, including client buffers/retries and fanout, with no default literal. All content comes from validated versioned configuration/backend state and retains source/LIVE/REPLAY/SIM labels. No sample fallback, interpolated gaps, averaged disagreement or fabricated null-to-zero. Every module has a non-safety configuration edit test. Scratch threshold edits follow D15 and update matching hazard/limit documents consistently, never shipped data or level/raiser safety mappings. Independent clinical goldens are checked against the cited source by another reviewer, never derived only from the configuration under test. All loops/calls are bounded; no recursion or unchecked returns; typed errors and strict types, no Any outside generated code.

Tests first on each assigned critical path, traced to the design's T-E24/R/V/D/INV identifiers. Full acceptance uses the normal composed hub HTTP API and real temporary SQLite, or actual UI against that hub, explicit E21 demo profile, normal authentication/loader/audit/outbox/ledger. No mocks/dependency overrides inside the hub, direct SQL seeds, browser route interception or fake internal providers in end-to-end tests. Only optional external processes use documented provider fakes or are absent. Missing counterpart never becomes skip/xfail/empty-success. Preserve every clause of V/D, not just the warning row. All AGENTS section 6 faults apply: kill/power loss at every command step, before/after commit/response, duplicate/delayed/retried inputs, clock corrections/mission-day boundaries, disk full/locked/I/O, corrupt/missing configuration, partial/implausible/disagreeing readings, two clients, long ground backlog, absent/incapacitated crew and cross-crew privacy. A bug gets its failing regression first; after a fix rerun the full E24 backend and browser suites when supplied. Never run git. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash. Done additionally requires independent build review, green CI and coordinator AI-use rows, outside your edit scope. Missing gates/prerequisites are reported as blocked, not passed.

Build the single warnings safety-core concern: E24 sections 3.1 to 3.17, 4, 5, 6 and 8 through 12, corrected above, and section 15 steps 1 to 7 plus backend acceptance/measurements in step 9. Leave Vue/store/browser tests to T2; sensor ingestion/aggregation/trust to E23; records to E01; bindings to E25; help to E26; guidance rule to E27; model and output verification to E12/E13/E17. No worker framework or new clinical condition kinds. All production Python paths are the explicit section 13 inventory (docs/tdd/E24.md:1359); the permitted test roots also come from that inventory. Ownership expansion for module.py, architecture.toml and replica.schema.json must be granted separately (PLAN Request 4); do not create them, put assembly in __init__.py or edit E01's shared config. Ask the coordinator to deliver that registration handoff before executable composition gates. Pure work and port tests can proceed after E01 types/fakes exist; integration waits on the corresponding requests.

Start with E24 3.1/3.2: vocabulary mirrors generated warning/common/config-warning-rules enums; WarningDefinition is schema-validated once per retained release; fingerprint.py separates content_hash from rule_fingerprint and includes the full referenced-limit/aggregation/catalog/questionnaire/assistant-policy dependencies listed at docs/tdd/E24.md:101. Implement known typed errors and domain invariant checks. Loader checks from E24 8 and R-E24-10 only reject invalid candidates, never downgrade validation or invent a configured prohibited-phrase list. Keep the source for the phrase rule a coordinator prerequisite if its configuration declaration is missing. D1 supersedes the design no_retire_active blanket veto and changes tests 016/127 to prove retained pins/withdrawn state without blocking a valid removal; no kind/scope migration rewrites old state. rules.expiry_scope keeps rule expiry from becoming recovery evidence; dizzy_after_landing has null notification expiry as E24 8 specifies. Escalation in 3.7 remains per-definition/channel, equal-level hazards coexist, lower levels do not flap under higher ones, level never mutates, and previous_warning_id links supersession/de-escalation.

Use E24 4.3's frozen Warning, TriggerRef, Occurrence, DwellMarker, RuleInput/EngineView/RenderValues/Projection/WarningView/HeadlineView/HeldSummary and Decision variants as local domain values, with the SYSTEM TimeInput/Quantity and agreed seam corrections. WarningRepository, OccurrenceRepository, DwellRepository and ReplicaRepository remain application ports from 4.2. PendingRepository is superseded by E01 isolation, not a protocol to copy. Required producer inputs are SensorEvaluated/ChannelFreshnessChanged, MissionEventRecorded/StateFactChanged/OverlayChanged/EnvironmentActivated, AnswerAccepted, insight and ground facts, release/clock events and supplies. Import producer application protocols and map to local domain inputs in subscriptions.py; do not copy producer DTO declarations. E23 4.2/4.3 at docs/tdd/E23.md:424/500 provides SensorStateQuery and MissionStatePort; current/environment/mode can be absent before mission initialization. Missing mission state is unavailable, never an invented environment/mode. E01 R-E01-17 supplies records AnswerAccepted/AnswerQuery/RecordFactsPort; E13 supplies InsightQuery; E29 must publish GroundLinkQuery.current; its design/request files are absent on the final recheck. Canonical supply types are SYSTEM 8.1 at docs/SYSTEM.md:1884: SupplyPartition, CoverFact, SupplyCoverChanged and SupplyCoverFacts.rows(view, *, partition, after_supply_id, limit), defined only in supplies/application/ports.py. They include quantity_now/per_use Quantity, release_id, stock_revision and source_refs. Do not implement E24's local CoverFact/SupplyCoverInput replacement. Preserve partition, source and stock revision; rescan startup/activation; Q19 leaves below_uses null in deployment.

Implement ApplyRuleInput and decision application from E24 4.1/4.3: correct spent-trigger identity, every outstanding mission occurrence, strictly causal clear events, deterministic clears/supersessions before raises, immutable evidence/steps and revision. For a clear, use the raised warning's own pin, limit and origin. Same E never advances dwell; false/None/missing result, stale/unknown clock, future observation, excessive gaps, pending state and startup staleness break continuity; historical backlog may raise with original evidence, never clear a newer warning. A frozen clear also forbids supersession that would lower/clear old state while pending. Avoid deleting dwell as an uncommitted side effect on typed failure: pending interlock invalidation follows the shared atomic mechanism. Resolving original TimeInput and partition high water needs the agreed R-E23-5/18/19 binding, never an arrived-at approximation. Deadlines for assistant lifetime/retry/Q9 routing are elapsed; ground next-contact silence is absolute and backward correction alone never clears it. Mission clock labels stay pinned. Only the ground-silence application adapter imports GroundLinkQuery; pure domain cannot import another module's application layer. Request exact approved cross-module declarations if missing.

Use sqlite_repository.py and migrations/0001_rules.sql through SYSTEM StorageSession only. Tables: rules_warning, rules_dwell, rules_trigger and rules_note are canonical SYSTEM 4.2; rules_trigger takes E24 5.1 occurrence columns and rules_note its note columns, replacing the older design names. Additional section 5.1 tables are rules_warning_ack, rules_deadline, rules_warning_replica and rules_replica_action. Do not create rules_pending or another kernel ledger/task/cursor table. Preserve all nullability/enums, active per-key partial uniqueness, immutable fields/final-state/append constraints and revision compare; include trigger_kind among immutable trigger identity checks. Local state writes declare ReplicationChange atomically; local-only private changes use export_projection=None with safe references. Expand-only migration, no foreign key into producer tables, no rollback that drops accepted records. Existing warning scope/evidence never become a full replica write model. Replica apply consumes Delivery/Recipient through SYSTEM 5.7.1 rather than raw origin sequences. Only allowed habitat/crew leaf fields export under rules/operational/1; missing dependencies are withheld/pending, no private IDs/hashes. Ack/note transport waits on accepted projection, not automatic arbitrary append export.

Provide WarningQueries.list/get/active_visible/headline/count_active_visible/active_shared_at_or_above/visible, WarningCommands.act/attach_routine_overrides, InsightWarningPort and AssistantWarningGuard exactly E24 4.2 once agreed snapshot corrections are published. No unbounded all-warning sequence masquerading as a complete list; use bounded reads and SQL count/headline, fail visibly if a required complete projection cannot be represented. held_summary/care_view are integrated only with the approved projections/grants, never a chart exception. E03 and E26 consume the published ports; E23 requires a caller-UOW warning query before atomic sensor recomposition. WarningRaised/WarningCleared are E24 domain notifications as E24 4.3/4.4; E25 attaches overrides in the same UOW. Outbox warning.raised/updated/cleared stores lifecycle only with allowed_actions empty, current audience metadata mandatory; session projections are fetched. Current ResultVisibility applies to events and receipts.

API is exactly listWarnings GET /v1/warnings?state=&cursor=&limit=, getWarning GET /v1/warnings/{warning_id}, actOnWarning POST /v1/warnings/{warning_id}/actions (docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:2529 and E24 6). Boundary WarningAction comes from generated requests.schema.json#/$defs/WarningAction (docs/product/api/schemas/requests.schema.json:246): acknowledge/resolve/dismiss/add_note and conditional reason/note. Copy x-roles and HTTP headers/statuses exactly. Generate no alternate request class or endpoint. Authenticate/role/current access first, validate malformed versus field errors, full-identity replay lookup before mutable conditions and again in IMMEDIATE, then visibility/If-Match/config-dependent Config-Release/action. Authorized matching replay respects SYSTEM 5.8 rather than stale If-Match; target/semantic/body mismatch conflicts. Enforce Config-Release for new resolve; acknowledge does not depend on mutable rule config. Use E24 6.2 typed errors with D5/D6 receipt corrections. E24 R-E24-13 needs effective error declaration agreement, not a silent schema extension.

Rendering is E24 5.2: TemplateRenderer plus per-limit LimitRenderFacts, never E24 sensor arithmetic/formatting. Each oxygen hazard shows its own aggregation/value/limit/source; ChannelRenderFacts supplies channel words. Words come from warning-rules.json, sensor-limits.json, sensor-catalog.json, environment-hazards.json, ui-copy.json, assistant-policy.json, environment-profiles.json, questionnaires.json and routine-rules.json as E24 8 lists; only warning-rules.json is editable here. Read versioned documents through the real release loader; no package file reads at runtime and no examples as implicit production seeds. The explicit test example_release uses docs/product/api/examples/config/*.example.json value payloads under its labeled test profile. E24 deployment content follows 8 with D2/Q1: emergency radiation_storm_shelter with the cited radiation act shelter sentences as listed steps, source-neutral wording, dizzy expiry null, no vehicle event types before R-E24-9 approval, no invented radiation/supply threshold. Cross-check source text and provenance before writing it. R-E24-2/16 supply new warning words; no hardcoded fallback text. GuidanceEligibility.evaluate gets the original content hash/release/purpose and current facts after warning_steps is accepted; exact unreviewed label is preserved. Missing eligibility/source is unsupported with configured human path, never fabricated show. Assistant guard propose_action has no success type, and no AssistantActor reaches lifecycle actions. Insight bounds validate every E24 3.13 violation against actual own accepted records and namespace; valid watch with one action does not create the rule's morning task.

Tests first, all T-E24 numbers below refer to E24 12.2 at docs/tdd/E24.md:1244. Build hub/tests/rules/conftest.py only inside your test root using approved kernel fixtures; hub/tests/rules/golden/cases.yaml contains the independently checked source cases (E24 12); mutation_gate.py enforces >=0.80 and rejects empty/missing results. hub/tests/contracts/rules_inputs.py contains producer/consumer protocol assertions T112/113, run by providers without writing their files. Keep the explicit test IDs in markers and test names so nonempty trace gates can verify them.

Unit/property/golden suite: T001 to 012/018 to 022/026/027 to 029/035/036/040 to 043/045/046/060 to 066/080/081/084 to 087/089/114/118/120/131, traced to R36/R40/R43 and INV01 to INV10/12/14/17. Every parser/engine/rendering/clear policy gets 1000 deterministic property examples and independently fixed clinical outcomes. First regressions: two simultaneous oxygen act hazards with distinct rendered evidence; old all-clear after second trigger; old LIVE backlog delivered now; unknown/missing own limit result; same raw time in distinct clock segments; active-definition removal retaining old pin; forbidden assistant act/clear/dismiss; unknown cover; no forecast input and link independent except silence; source/purpose unknown not treated as clinical-review absence. Goldens use CONTRACTS 20 sourced vectors including explicit pressure, never an implicit 760.

Persistence/API/isolation suites: T006/007/013 to 017/023 to 025/030 to 034/037/038/044/047 to 059/067/068/070 to 077/083/088/090 to 092/100 to 102/104 to 114/119/122 to 133. Trace each to E24 12.1 and INV04 to INV19. Update T016/127 for D1 retained removal rather than expecting blanket rejection; T014/015/017/126 must test old pinned clear rules separately from new raise rules, not new threshold clearing. T124 returns the accepted-command receipt after 24 hours; T056 allows the safe SYSTEM receipt for P2 rather than demanding private cached 200. T130 expects eligible unreviewed steps with their label and denies missing source/purpose/hash/withdrawal, not absent clinical review alone. T132 has positive explicit grant, denied ordinary/officer/helper-only access, revocation and incapacitated subject's limited summary. Typed permanent failure, original pin recovery after 30 days, every forbidden error class, pending-marker/audit failure, duplicate completion and stale success after newer state are mandatory; no rules-local pending implementation. Saturate every approved bound while emergency records still raise; bounded query memory, disk reserve and visible faults are real platform behavior. T125 runs two real hub processes and authorized file sync, distinct IDs/origins and no foreign clear.

End-to-end assertions in your test root must drive HTTP through normal create_app(settings), not invoke only ApplyRuleInput. Implement every HTTP half of PLAN's end-to-end table: V10/V32/V55/V56/V57/V58/V65/V69/V70/V72/V74/V75, D16/D17/D19/D22 and all six E24 section 9 critical paths. Use real ingestReadings, authorized recordMissionEvent and answerDailyCheck/records producer path, listWarnings/getWarning/actOnWarning, getEvents, real config activation and confirmed environment change endpoints from generated OpenAPI. Inspect actual schemas/payloads before using those owner operations. For assistant scenarios drive E12/E13 with E17's documented external stub; for forecast, compare real optional forecast integration and absence. V69 covers the whole day and other safety providers, not just the warnings API. Require the real E25 CO2/reaction/post-storm effects, E23 trend/attendance/instrument/dust content and E26 help as appropriate. T136 stays E25 authored; T137/138 have actual provider effects. T2 owns the rendered evidence and you do not edit it. Whole-scenario missing clauses block completion.

Final backend gates select the full directory, contract test and real HTTP journeys together, with >=95% branch coverage on rules domain/application, 100% safety-decision condition coverage and complexity <=15, mutation >=80% and all T/R/V/D IDs present. E01 scripts/validate_hub.py currently has E01-specific coverage/trace inventory: PLAN Request 6 must make its trace/safety selection enforce E24 before you count that gate. Generated import inventory must include the stricter rules-no-vehicle-write and rules-ground-link-only-silence contracts after the approved architecture registration. No plain successful lint-imports over an undiscovered module counts. Run full backend, T2 browser evidence and provider counterpart gates before epic done. Done for T1 means all its HTTP/property/storage/safety evidence and commands pass without missing prerequisites, plus a reviewed port/config handoff to T2. No claim that T2 or shared infrastructure is finished from T1's partial tests.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/rules hub/tests/contracts/rules_inputs.py --cov=crew_health.rules.domain --cov=crew_health.rules.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/rules hub/tests/rules hub/tests/contracts/rules_inputs.py
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/rules hub/tests/rules hub/tests/contracts/rules_inputs.py
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py corpus
uv run --project hub mutmut run --paths-to-mutate hub/src/crew_health/rules/domain
uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests

Build only warning presentation, E24 section 7, the presentation halves of 3.10/3.12/3.16 and the UI tests in 12/15 step 8. Leave rules, state changes, routing timer, projections, counts, ordering, eligibility and HTTP semantics to T1. E03 owns shell/design/Today assembly and ui-copy.json; E20 owns authenticated stream/client/queue/offline mechanisms; E26 owns help, E23 Habitat and E25 Changed for now. Do not recreate or edit them. Your sole owned directory is ui/crew/src/features/warnings/ (docs/tdd/E24.md:1374); put component and Playwright tests there so every test is owned. E24's old e2e/warnings command selects an unowned directory: use the scoped feature-directory browser command in gates only after E03/E20 configures real nonempty discovery. Do not edit Playwright/project tooling or create another fixture/runner.
